blocks.orig: The Mafia Kivulini Lodge is perfectly located inside Mafia’s marine park boundaries, which makes it a great place to start your snorkeling, diving, fishing, or whale shark expeditions. The lodge sits between ancient trees (kivulini means in the shadow in Swahili) are offers only 4 rooms with a maximum capacity of 8 guests, ensuring a private and tranquil atmosphere. The rooms are fitted with an ensuite bathroom, electric fans and air-conditioning, a private terrace, mosquito nets, a desk, a safe and free Wi-Fi. Breakfast and dinner are served in the restaurant, with breakfast consisting of seasonal fresh fruits, muffins, pancakes and more. Dinner is a 3-course set menu, mostly consisting of tropical dishes and fresh seafood, with the fishermen right outside on the ocean. The pool and the bicycle rent complete your beach stay.
blocks.html: The Mafia Kivulini Lodge has an ideal location within the boundaries of Mafia’s marine park, so it is a good base for snorkeling, diving, fishing or whale shark trips. Set among ancient trees (kivulini is Swahili for in the shadow), the lodge has just 4 rooms for a maximum of 8 guests, which keeps the atmosphere private and calm. Each room has an ensuite bathroom, electric fans and air-conditioning, a private terrace, mosquito nets, a desk, a safe and free Wi-Fi. The restaurant serves breakfast and dinner; breakfast includes fresh seasonal fruit, muffins, pancakes and more. Dinner is a set 3-course menu, made up mainly of tropical dishes and fresh seafood, with the fishermen working just outside on the ocean. A pool and bicycle hire round off your beach stay.
